entities.summary: Sir Muhammad Zafrulla Khan was a Pakistani diplomat and jurist who served as the First Minister for Foreign Affairs. After serving as foreign minister, he continued his international career and is the only Pakistani to-date to preside over the International Court of Justice. He also served as the President of the United Nations General Assembly. He is the only person to-date to serve as the President of both UN General Assembly and the International Court of Justice.
